_meta.warning: internal/catalog/compliance has NO _test.go file in the prior alpha — zero automated test coverage carried over. testdata/golden fixtures for this package need to be authored fresh during M2, not harvested; see harvest/NOTES.md.

terminology_review.action: stays VISIBLE, queued for review, reason=terminology_review, detail='review terminology: <matched text>'
terminology_review.why: ADR-008 / 04-PIPELINE.md §5 — hard-blocking a product for containing the word 'marijuana' is wrong for a cannabis-education catalogue. This exact bug hid CannEx Strong Plus in the prior alpha.

service_listing.matched_against: product NAME only ('class' alone deliberately excluded — matches 'world-class')
service_listing.action: hidden (Pass=false), reason=compliance_uncertain, detail='service/event listing, not a product: <matched text>'
service_listing.why: Marketplace aggregators list events/services (retreats, workshops) alongside real products in their 'experiences' sections — a ₹4-lakh retreat must never appear in a product catalogue.

price_anomaly.action: queued for review, reason=price_anomaly, only checked when priceINR > 0 AND pricePMG > 0
price_anomaly.note: 04-PIPELINE.md §5 documents this same 0.10/100 band; ADR-016 replaces the one-time-freeze tuning plan for these numbers with an ongoing AI-assisted, human-approved process.

unknown_brand.action: queued for review, reason=unknown_brand, when brandSlug is empty OR not in the approved-brands allowlist
unknown_brand.trusted_aggregators_note: These three slugs auto-pass the brand check even when the specific brand isn't yet in our DB (09-OPS.md §6 confirms the same three, with cbdstore.in = 'CBD Store India').

matching: word_boundary throughout, never substring — confirmed no strings.Contains anywhere in filter.go
